author: Yawi
quote: I tried the game and honestly it feels like red dead redemption 2 graphics have the gta gameplay, the lack of face expressions it’s something impressive, there’s really no dynamics face expressions, they are very stiff, emotionless, it’s monotonous to have the same history/ gameplay from previous games, its repetitive, I found it very unpleasant to see all the nudity in the way it was portrayed, I don’t think this games adds up morals to the youth in any way, the color palette wasn’t something beautiful to appreciate, it didn’t felt like art, it’s not something that personally captivated me, after I saw the satanic mission there is, human sacrifice I didn’t wanted to play the game, uninstalled it.

author: Yawi
quote: First able I thought I wanted a 2.1 remake, something like resident evil or final fantasy which was insane to me, now I just finished ocarina, and the game was truly a masterpiece, how beautiful it is, Nintendo never disappoints in this type of exclusive games, it was truly beautiful.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
